title: Split-thickness skin grafts directly to bone for marginal mandibulectomy reconstruction: a case series
html: Oncologic resection of oral cavity malignancies can result in defects requiring epithelial coverage. While microvascular free flaps are considered the gold standard, split-thickness skin grafts (STSGs) offer a simpler alternative for selected marginal mandibulectomy defects and patients. This case series describes the use of STSGs to reconstruct marginal mandibulectomy defects at a tertiary Australian head and neck oncology service between April 2019 and October 2024. Eleven patients underwent resection and immediate reconstruction with STSGs.
